Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking the meeting last week. We're starting vendor registration in our AP system and need a few items from you to set Redwood up as an approved supplier. Please confirm the fields below and return the requested evidence:

Required (for US vendors):
- Legal name (exact)
- Tax ID / EIN (formatted: XX-XXXXXXX)
- W-9 (PDF, signed)
- Remittance email for invoice delivery (we prefer an inbox that creates tickets)
- Preferred remit address for our records

Invoice/PO handling requirements:
- PO number must be populated in the "PO Number" header field of the invoice in our portal (Coupa integration). If the PO is missing, the invoice will route to a GL hold and delay payment.
- Invoice must reference the corresponding PO line or show a single invoice line per PO number for automated matching.
- Payment terms: NET45 (exceptions require approval and a signed SOW/PO amendment).
- Early-pay program available separately after vendor activation (opt-in).

Security/transfer items:
- We ask vendors to submit bank account details via our secure tokenization link (we cannot accept bank details by unencrypted email).

I've attached our onboarding template to speed this up. Once you submit the packet and tax docs through the portal we will validate and issue a test PO for your first invoice.

Portal link: https://portal.collectivehealth.com/vendor_signup
Attachment: Collective_AP_onboarding_template.xlsx (XLSX)

Can you send the packet back this week? If you prefer, we can accept the W-9 via DocuSign link as well.

Best,

Mina / Emily,

On Coupa and our downstream ERP, automated matching works best when: 
1) The PO Number is present in the "PO Number" meta field (not buried in the invoice body).
2) Each invoice line references either a PO line number or a single consolidated PO reference. For consolidated POs, we require a reference mapping CSV during the first invoice submission so AP can seed the matching table.

If those elements are missing, invoices will go into a GL investigation queue and require manual approval (this typically adds 2–3 payment cycles). Exceptions are evaluated but must have a signed justification and approver name in the invoice notes.

For tax evidence: US entities need a signed W-9; non-US entities must provide VAT registration certificate and local tax ID.

Bank details: we provide vendors with a one-time secure tokenization URL after the vendor profile is created in the portal. Please do not email bank account numbers.

I'll ask AP to upload the vendor packet to the portal and trigger the tokenization email.

Procurement Helpdesk
